text:
tess: quick ask  thinking about adding a compact 'Roles summary' column to the invite modal table so reviewers can see at-a-glance: direct roles, via-team, and SSO state. dropping figma link: https://figma.redwood.app/file/roles-summary-v1

mira: seems useful for reviewers. two immediate concerns: 1) width pressure in the modal, 2) how we surface multiple sources without visual clutter.

dave: implementation thought: show a condensed stack: first role chip, then small badges for 'Via: team' and 'SSO' if present. tooltip expands full list. avoids blowing out width.

noah: perf: if we render tooltips with full role lists for every row we could spike memory. prefer tooltip content to be fetched lazily on focus/hover. we already have role list in payload so client can build it, but defer heavy rendering until interaction.

kevin: a11y: make sure the summary column has clear accessible name e.g., aria-label="Roles summary for <user>" and that the tooltip is exposed via aria-describedby when visible. Also SSO badge needs an aria-label like "SSO enforced" and must meet 4.5:1 contrast for small text.

mira: copy nit: current placeholder says 'No roles yet' in several spots. For invites I think 'No roles assigned' is clearer. Also prefer verb 'Assign role' across buttons.

tess: good catch. decision candidate: unifying verb to 'Assign role' across drawer + modal. any objections?

dave: agree on the verb. For the compact summary, propose these rules: - show up to 2 role chips + "+N" popover - show 'Via: <team>' short badge when inherited - show SSO badge (lock icon) when enforced - tooltip/expanded view on hover/focus that lists full items.

noah: virtualization note: modal can show up to 200 rows in some tests. ensure we reuse row components and avoid mounting tooltips for offscreen rows. use IntersectionObserver to lazy-init heavy tooltip content.

kevin: keyboard order: tab -> row -> expand +N -> kebab -> audit. people often hit kebab expecting row actions; keep expand earlier in order. add role-row:focus-within style so screen reader users see the grouping.

mira: what about audit access? currently 'View audit' lives in kebab. suggestion: add a lightweight inline link 'Audit' in the summary column when the row has changes recently. route: /audit?entity=user&id=<id>&kind=role. keeps context.

tess: I like inline 'Audit' for recent changes. let's limit to rows with role events in last 30 days to avoid clutter.

dave: UX microcopy: For the SSO badge, text = 'SSO' visually; aria-label = 'SSO required for this user'. For inherited badge, visual = 'Via: infra' aria-label = 'Via team: infra (inherits this role)'.

kevin: CSS snippet to include in component spec:

```
.roles-summary { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; min-width:120px }
.role-chip { padding:4px 6px; font-size:13px }
.sso-badge { background:#012A4A; color:#fff; border-radius:6px; padding:2px 6px }
.more-pill { min-width:36px; text-align:center }
```

and ensure :focus-visible not removed.

mira: localization: 'Via:' might not translate cleanly everywhere. we should use full key 'roles.via_label' so translators can pick best short form per locale. fallback to 'Via:' only when token missing.

noah: accessibility behavior: when tooltip opens on long-press (mobile) ensure it doesn't double-read prefix + tooltip. update ARIA so only the tooltip is described when visible (swap aria-describedby).

tess: checklist to land design -> dev: 1) update figma with compact summary tokens, 2) unify verb to 'Assign role', 3) SSO badge style + aria-label, 4) show up to 2 chips + +N, 5) inline 'Audit' only for recent changes, 6) perf acceptance: render 200 rows under 150ms. target: dev PR by next Thurs.

designbot: created task UI-2103 and added tags: a11y, perf, i18n, spec.

dave: i'll include IntersectionObserver lazy-init and keyboard-order tests in the estimate.

kevin: last tiny nit: ensure that screen readers don't announce both 'Via: infra' badge and hover tooltip content. use aria-live polite on dynamic status changes only.

mira: thanks all. i'll push the figma update and add localization tokens. closing until PR lands. :thumbsup:
